description:
Read the properties and relationships of microsoft.graph.security.sensorCandidateActivationConfiguration object.

TIP: Gets the global sensor candidate activation configuration — controls how DfI handles newly-detected sensor candidates. Returns the autoActivation flag (whether candidates are auto-promoted to sensors), automation rules (criteria for auto-activation), and notification settings.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

name: get-sensor-candidate-activation-config
